newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends up on Lujiazui buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends up on Lujiazui buying.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed slightly up on Monday largely on buying of real estate developer Lujiazui by domestic brokerages following the share's sharp falls last week, traders said.
The index edged up 0.426 points or 0.64 percent to 67.061 points, on volume of 18.1 million shares worth $9.2 million.
Traders said domestic institutions did window-dressing buying today, pushing up both Lujiazui's price and the B index.
Lujiazui fell sharply last week due to the dilution of the value of its existing shares by a three-for-10 rights issue earlier this month, brokers said.
Lujiazui traded the most, rising $0.014 or 1.07 percent to $1.316 on volume of 2.5 million shares.
Of 42 B shares, 41 traded, with 25 up, seven flat and nine down.
But brokers said trading was slow with overseas investors staying on the sidelines in the aftermath of the Christmas holiday.
"Most domestic investors focused their buying on shares which are expected to post good results," one broker said.

"The index is likely to meet psychological resistance around the 68-point level, but the performance of individual stocks in the short term will depend the trends in speculative trading by institutions," a second broker said.
Bicycle maker Phoenix was the star on a technical rebound, jumping $0.014 or 8.23 percent to $0.184, on volume of 457,700 shares.
Textile company Worldbest followed on active domestic buying triggered by its recent acquistion of two firms, brokers said. It rose $0.018 or 4.50 percent to $0.418, on volume of 2.0 millin shares.

Shanghai A share closed up thanks to rises in the Shenzhen market, but most investors were cautious about following-up due to lingering concerns about policy risks following the official crackdown two weeks ago, brokers said.

The A index gained 12.565 points or 1.31 percent to 973.467 points, on volume of 507.5 million shares worth 4.7 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 22.077 points or 0.90 percent to 2467.689 points.
Gold producer Luyin Group was the star on speculative buying, soaring 1.62 yuan or 10.00 percent to 17.80 yuan, on volume of 3.4 million shares.
